# ADBPack — ISO 9001:2015 Custom Packaging Manufacturer & Global Exporter (India)

> ADBPack is an ISO 9001:2015 certified B2B custom packaging manufacturer and international exporter headquartered in New Delhi, India. Operating a 50,000 sq.ft manufacturing plant with a monthly capacity of 10,000,000+ units, ADBPack manufactures custom mono cartons, luxury rigid boxes, corrugated shipping boxes, flexible barrier pouches, cold-seal and hot-seal blister cards, self-adhesive roll labels, cylindrical paper tube canisters, and custom printed BOPP tapes for brands across India, South Asia, the Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman), Africa, Europe, UK, North America (USA, Canada), and Australia.

## Quick Facts (Entity Summary)
- **Company Name:** ADBPack
- **Founded:** 2018
- **Founder & CEO:** Latika Upadhyay
- **Headquarters & Plant:** Trilokpuri, New Delhi, Delhi 110091, India
- **Facility Size:** 50,000 sq.ft automated printing & converting plant
- **Production Capacity:** 10,000,000+ packaging units per month
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System, GeM (Government e-Marketplace) Registered, MSME Registered
- **Pricing Model:** Custom B2B wholesale & export quotation based on dimensions, substrate GSM, printing, finishes, and order volume
- **Export Track Record:** Supplies international brands including Shree Distillery Limited (Nepal), HairSmart Inc., Delbruk, Farmacos, Primus, and healthcare/FMCG exporters
- **Website:** https://adbpack.com

## Product Catalog & Technical Specifications

### 1. Mono Cartons — https://adbpack.com/product/mono-cartons
Custom offset-printed folding cartons for pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, nutraceuticals, personal care, and FMCG products.
- **MOQ:** 2,000 sheets
- **Substrates:** Virgin SBS (Solid Bleached Sulfate / FBB), Coated Duplex Board, Natural Kraft Board (250–450 GSM)
- **Finishes:** Matt/Gloss/Velvet/Holographic Lamination, Spot UV, Drip-Off UV, Hot Foil Stamping (Gold/Silver), 3D Embossing/Debossing, Die-Cut PVC Window, Aqueous Coating

### 2. Luxury Rigid Boxes — https://adbpack.com/product/rigid-boxes
High-strength rigid setup boxes for luxury D2C brands, perfumes, cosmetics, watches, jewelry, premium spirits/liquor, and corporate gifting.
- **MOQ:** 1,000 boxes
- **Construction:** 1.5mm–3.0mm high-density greyboard wrapped with specialty art paper, textured paper, or soft-touch velvet film
- **Styles & Inserts:** Magnetic flap closure, telescope two-piece, shoulder-neck, slide drawer; custom die-cut EVA foam, velvet-flocked trays, satin, or paperboard inserts

### 3. Corrugated Boxes — https://adbpack.com/product/corrugated-boxes
Structurally engineered E-flute printed D2C mailer boxes and 3-ply, 4-ply, and 5-ply B2B master shipping cartons.
- **MOQ:** 2,000 sheets
- **Construction:** 3-Ply (Single Wall), 4-Ply, 5-Ply (Double Wall), E-Flute litho-laminated boxes; 100% recyclable Kraft & Virgin liners
- **Features:** High bursting factor (BF) and edge crush test (ECT) strength for domestic logistics and international sea/air freight; inside-out printing

### 4. Flexible Packaging Pouches — https://adbpack.com/product/pouches
Multi-layer barrier pouches for food, coffee, tea, spices, protein powders, snacks, pet food, and agrochemicals.
- **MOQ:** 5,000 pouches
- **Formats:** Stand-up pouches (Doypack), 3-side seal flat pouches, center-seal gusseted pouches, liquid spout pouches
- **Laminates & Printing:** PET/PE, BOPP/PE, PET/AL/PE (aluminum foil barrier), Metallized PET; up to 9-color rotogravure printing; resealable zippers, tear notches, clear windows

### 5. Cold Seal Blister Packaging — https://adbpack.com/product/cold-seal-blisters
Pressure-sensitive cohesive coated blister cards requiring zero heat to seal—ideal for heat-sensitive pharmaceuticals, probiotics, confectionery, and FMCG goods.
- **MOQ:** 3,000–5,000 sheets
- **Substrates:** High-stiffness SBS and Duplex board with tamper-evident cohesive seal coating

### 6. Hot Seal Blister Packaging — https://adbpack.com/product/hot-seal-blisters
Heat-seal varnish coated backing cards engineered to bond securely with thermoformed PVC, PET, and PETG blisters for retail pegboard display.
- **Substrates:** SBS and Duplex board with high-gloss lamination, foil stamping, and custom euro/round hang holes

### 7. Self-Adhesive Labels — https://adbpack.com/product/self-adhesive-labels
High-resolution die-cut labels supplied on rolls (for automatic bottle/vial labeling lines) or sheets.
- **MOQ:** 5,000 labels
- **Face Materials:** Chromo Paper, Waterproof White/Clear/Metallized BOPP, PE, PET
- **Adhesives:** Permanent Acrylic, High-Tack Rubber Hot-Melt, Removable

### 8. Canister Boxes (Paper Tubes) — https://adbpack.com/product/canister-boxes
Cylindrical composite paper tube cans for specialty tea, coffee, spices, dry fruits, cosmetics, candles, and liquor bottles.
- **MOQ:** 2,000 canisters
- **Specifications:** Custom diameters from 50mm to 150mm; food-grade aluminum foil inner barrier lining; tinplate, plastic, or paper lids; 360-degree branded wrap

### 9. Promotional Printed Tape Rolls — https://adbpack.com/product/promotional-tape-roll
Tamper-evident custom logo printed BOPP carton sealing tape.
- **MOQ:** 500 rolls
- **Specifications:** 48mm and 72mm widths; 65m or custom lengths; up to 3-color printing; acrylic or hot-melt adhesive
